name: velista-luna-e2e
// implicitDependencies: The suite drives velista's screens against the five services a basket touches (velista plan 0080, section 2). A change to any of them marks this project affected, which is what makes the browser gate in docker-ci.yml run.
// e2e: Playwright, against a velista origin and a gateway that are ALREADY running: a dev slot locally (tools/dev/ng-slot.sh, luna-slot.sh), or the two compose stacks in CI. playwright.config.ts has no webServer and dependsOn is [], as on velista-e2e, so nothing here starts a serve of its own.

e2e.//: Uncached, for the reason luna-shopper-backend-e2e gives: the result depends on a live stack and on VELISTA_BASE_URL / E2E_GATEWAY_URL, none of which Nx hashes. A replayed cache entry would be a pass that sent no request.
